facts.fact: Darragh 骑马带 Rory 回老家（茅草顶别墅、拴两匹马的小马厩、大羊圈），向母亲 Justinia 介绍：Rory 约 1 周前穿越 threshing wall、刚在 Relystone 被 4 名男子袭击；母亲看见 Rory 的圆耳朵捂嘴惊问「A human?」，随后答应让她洗澡并给她干净裙子穿。
facts.anchor: “Mom, this is Rory. She crossed the threshing wall about a week ago, and she just had a traumatic run-in with some rather brutal men.”

facts.fact: Rory 在房门口偷听到母子对话：Justinia 打趣 Darragh 头一回带女人回家、还说「我的 enchant 从来没错过」，Darragh 压低声音澄清自己只是护送 Rory 回 Edenalee 的护卫，不是那种关系。
facts.anchor: “It…This is not that. I am her escort and will be protecting her until we can get her back to Edenalee.”

facts.fact: Justinia 进卧室帮 Rory 解开背上够不着的最后一颗扣子，随后压低声音说她与 Darragh 一样封闭、两人有许多相同特质，还说很高兴她走进这个 realm。
facts.anchor: “He’s a bit closed off, but so are you. You share so many of the same qualities.”

facts.fact: Rory 洗完澡、换上 Justinia 年轻时的淡黄色旧裙后，把那件染血的裙子愤怒地扔进燃着的壁炉烧成灰，并决定用学会更好地保护自己和女儿来报答在森林里帮她脱险的神祇。
facts.anchor: The discarded blood-stained dress lay in a heap on the floor. I angrily tossed it into the lit fireplace, watching it burn to ash with my vulnerability alongside it.

facts.fact: 走廊上 Rory 撞见刚洗完澡、只围毛巾的 Darragh：手臂有树叶缠绕、骷髅点缀的纹身，肩胛间是展翅乌鸦纹身，左胸心口上方有一道长疤；她赶紧快步走开，希望没被他看见。
facts.anchor: On his back was a raven tattoo with wings spread across his shoulder blades. There was a long scar on the left side of his chest over his heart.

facts.fact: 餐桌上 Rory 见到 Darragh 的父亲 Amos（蜜金色头发、鬓角灰白、栗色眼睛），向两老讲述来历：与女儿 Cora 坠穿墙、遭树妖袭击、被 Gabriel 找到、见过国王王后；Cora 现留在城堡随王室幼童上学、活动。
facts.anchor: “Hello, Rory. I’m Amos, Darragh’s father.” He pushed in my chair as I sat.

facts.fact: Darragh 向父母告辞：必须赶在有人问话之前把 Rory 送回城堡，因为他按规定不得带她出城墙；Justinia 含泪拥抱两人送别，Amos 叮嘱别让任何人惹上麻烦。
facts.anchor: “I know. I’m sorry. I have to get Rory back, so they don’t ask questions. I am not supposed to have her outside of the city walls.”

facts.fact: 返程马背上 Rory 问父母是否知道他杀人，Darragh 确认父母知道、明白他杀人是为了保护他人且出于必要而非乐趣；Rory 透露自己 4 年前为让女儿摆脱贵族牢笼而逃离贵族生活，Darragh 说她父母是傻瓜、又称她是好母亲。
facts.anchor: “Kill people who deserve it?” He sighed. “They know that I do what I have to do to keep others safe. That I do things out of necessity, not enjoyment.”

facts.fact: 回到城堡庭院，angheal 贵妇们对两人同骑侧目窃语，Rory 启动 plan B、当众谎称自己坠马走失母马，以掩盖与 Darragh 同行；Darragh 低声约定次日晚餐前在无人的 sparring ring 教她格斗。
facts.anchor: “Time for plan B.” His head cocked to the side, and his brows creased. “Thank you for helping me after falling off my horse, Captain. That mare spooks so easily! I hope you can find her,”
